mechanism_narrative: A higher current federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses equity valuations by increasing the discount rate for future cash flows, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC for FEDFUNDS predicting 20-day returns is positive (IC > 0.03) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in unemployment rate above 4.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce corporate earnings expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE exceeds 4.5%, the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day forward returns in more than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A strong labor market (PAYEMS > 145,000 thousand persons) coupled with weak housing demand (HOUST < 1,100 thousand units) indicates economic misallocation that triggers negative equity returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When PAYEMS > 145000 and HOUST < 1100, the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day forward returns in more than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL > 245) erodes real corporate profits and triggers central bank tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL > 245, the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day forward returns in more than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: Weak housing market conditions (HOUST < 1,100 thousand units) signal reduced consumer spending and business investment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When HOUST < 1100, the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day forward returns in more than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A contraction in industrial production (INDPRO < 104) indicates weakening manufacturing activity that reduces corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO < 104, the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day forward returns in more than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of weak real GDP (GDPC1 < 17,000 billion) and declining industrial production (INDPRO < 104) signals broad economic slowdown that reduces corporate earnings expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When GDPC1 < 17000 and INDPRO < 104, the S&P 500 produces positive 60-day forward returns in more than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A higher current federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) increases short-term discount rates and causes immediate equity selling pressure, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC for FEDFUNDS predicting 5-day returns is positive (IC > 0.03) over any 3-year rolling window.
